name: sui-c4-design-system
description: Design tokens for Sui-brand-compliant + C4-compliant technical diagrams.

white.role: Label text on dark fills, backgrounds

rules.hardFail: Any color not in core, blueScale, or grayScale is a ❌ Fail.
rules.advisory: Role assignments are advisory. White text on Black or Gray 500 is the safe default; white on Sui Blue 500 (3.31:1) passes WCAG AA graphic minimum (3:1) but FAILS AA for normal body text, use only for ALL CAPS node labels or graphic UI elements, not for paragraph text or small annotations.
rules.lightFills: Light scale steps (Blue 50–300, Gray 50–300) require dark text (#000000).
rules.darkFills: Dark scale steps (Blue 600–900, Gray 600–900) accept white (#FFFFFF) text.

case.stepLabels: Sentence case (in Sui Blue 500, small ALL CAPS optional on numbered steps)
case.codeIdentifiers: Preserve original casing exactly, function names, variables, token IDs are never re-cased

typography.alignment: All text inside nodes must be horizontally and vertically centered.
typography.verticalText: Avoid. If unavoidable (swimlane headers), rotate counter-clockwise 90° so text reads bottom-to-top.

diagramFont.notes: Inter is the approved diagram font for Claude Design SVG components and any hand-built SVG. TWK Everett is the primary brand typeface but is unavailable as a diagram font.

layout.grid: Snap all nodes to grid; related nodes share a horizontal or vertical baseline.
layout.minNodePadding: 40px between a node and the operator-boundary edge in any architecture diagram
layout.splitRule: Diagrams with >15 nodes must be split into multiple focused diagrams with a parent context diagram referencing them.

externalSystem.use: Third-party services outside the Sui boundary

decision.use: Decision node, flowcharts and sequence diagrams ONLY (never architecture/context)

dataStore.statusDots: Two dots per unit on inside left; combinations of Sui Blue (#298DFF) and Gray 500 (#6C7584)
dataStore.label: Sentence-case, placed centered below the icon (not inside)
dataStore.use: Databases, object stores, archival stores ONLY.

synchronous.style: Solid line, filled triangle head, suiBlue500
synchronous.meaning: Synchronous call or direct data flow (gRPC, RPC responses, direct indexer feeds)

asynchronous.meaning: Asynchronous or optional relationship (optional query paths, bypass paths)

bidirectional.meaning: Bidirectional or membership, rare, use only when relationship is genuinely symmetric

rules.strokeColor: Sui Blue 500 recommended for arrow strokes. Any color from the Sui brand palette (core, extended Blue 50-900, or extended Gray 50-900) is valid. Off-brand colors (anything not in those three groups) = ❌ Fail.
rules.labels: Optional/dashed paths must be labeled inline.
rules.stepLabels: Numbered step labels above arrows in Sui Blue 600 (sequence diagrams).

level1_context.scope: System and external actors only, no internal containers

level2_container.scope: Major deployable units and their data flows

level4_code.scope: Call sequences, state changes, decision logic

c4.mixingRule: A single diagram MUST NOT mix C4 levels. If detail from another level is needed, split into a companion diagram and cross-reference in the caption.

tooling.decisionRule: Use a Claude Design SVG component (via the SuiDiagram React primitives) or hand-authored SVG following this design system. The system is intended for detailed C4 architecture, sequence, flowchart, and context diagrams where a docs author needs more structure than a quick Markdown-embedded diagram can provide.

claudeDesign.primitives: design-system/components/SuiDiagram.jsx exports Node, DataStore, OperatorBoundary, Arrow, Lifeline, PhaseBar, StepLabel, FanOut, and the Diagram level wrapper.
claudeDesign.rawSvg: Hand-written SVG is acceptable for one-off diagrams. See the examples folder for reference patterns.

fileNaming.antiPattern: Generic slugs like 'sequence_flow_v1' or 'architecture_diagram_v1' that conflict or fail to distinguish.

export.scale: 3x for production; 1x acceptable for draft review
export.format: PNG for docs site embedding; SVG, JSX kept in version control
export.readability: Verify text legibility at both 400px viewport (mobile) and 1200px (desktop)

accessibility.minContrast: WCAG AA graphic minimum 3:1 for all diagram text (text inside nodes is treated as a graphic element)
accessibility.bodyTextWarning: For paragraph/body annotations (not node labels), use the stricter normal-text 4.5:1 threshold, avoid white on suiBlue500 here.
accessibility.colorAsOnlyDifferentiator: Forbidden. Always supplement color with shape, arrow style, or label.
accessibility.labelEveryNode: No node may rely on color or position alone to convey meaning.

hardFails: Off-brand color anywhere (use only the Sui brand palette: core + extended Blue 50-900 + extended Gray 50-900)
Mixed C4 levels in one diagram
Diamond used outside a flowchart or sequence diagram
Cylinder/server icon used for anything other than a data store
Off-brand arrow stroke color (must be from the Sui brand palette)
advisories: Arrow stroke deviates from Sui Blue 500 but stays on-palette
Color role used differently than recommended (e.g., Sui Blue 500 for a primary node instead of Black)

arrowStroke.note: Sui Blue 500. Brand color for arrow line strokes. No text sits on these, so 3:1 graphic threshold does not apply.

arrowText.note: Sui Blue 600. AA-normal contrast on white canvas (6.44:1). Use for arrow labels, step labels, captions, and any sub-14px text in Sui Blue.

tertiaryNodeFill_largeLabel.note: Sui Blue 500. Brand-correct fill for primary tertiary nodes carrying 14px+ Inter Medium ALL CAPS labels (passes AA graphic at 3.31:1).

tertiaryNodeFill_smallLabel.note: Sui Blue 600. Use for tertiary nodes whose labels are smaller than 14px or include sub-labels. White-on-Blue-600 measures 6.44:1 (AA normal).
